cohort: 130 maternal deaths (cases) and 336 live births (controls) at Lacor Hospital in northern Uganda from January 2015 to December 2019
finding: Maternal mortality was high among women who were referred late from other facilities, HIV positive, aged 30 years or older, lacked antenatal care attendance, and underwent cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with higher odds of maternal death (OR 2.22; 95% CI 1.13-4.37).
